text: Then came the confirmation that mattered most. At Bletchley Park, codebreakers decrypted a German message warning that the Allied invasion would come in the Balkans, with a feint toward the Dodecanese. A signal went to Churchill, then in the United States. Mincemeat, it said, had been swallowed rod, line and sinker by the right people.
